structured.answer: I'd go with Harel's "עוקב מדד s&p 500" track (fund 13414): Harel is a name I know, the fee was 0.56% and it showed 13.7% over 3 years. I'm not sure what to actually do next though, because the page never tells you how to open one.

stuck.where: Screens 2–5, the long list of tracks
stuck.why: There are 143 tracks and every company has the same ten or so names (מניות, כללי, עוקב מדד S&P 500…) with fees that are almost the same, 0.54%–0.71%. After the third company it was all a blur and I wanted to close it.
Many of the S&P rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, including the cheapest one (Altshuler 0.54%), so I couldn't compare the cheap one with the ones that do show a return.

stuck.where: Ring chart and the מניות / מט"ח percentages
stuck.why: I don't know what the yellow and teal ring means. I guessed teal is shares and yellow is 'foreign money', but 101% shares made no sense to me.

stuck.where: Rows that say 'עוד לא דווח' with an orange ! icon
stuck.why: It looked like a warning, so I avoided those rows (all of Migdal's deposit fees, plus the 'חדש' tracks).

findings.what: There are 143 almost identical rows and nothing points to a good choice, so I just wanted to leave
Fees only appear as tiny percents (0.54%, 0.56%), so they all look like nothing; no shekel amount for my money
The cheapest S&P track shows no return, only 'פחות מ־3 שנים', so I can't weigh price against performance
Orange '!' and 'עוד לא דווח' look like warnings and made me drop Migdal and all the new tracks
The ring chart and the מניות/מט"ח percents are never explained next to the chart; 101% shares looks like a mistake
Nothing tells me what to do next or how to open one
On my phone this wide table with tiny grey labels would be painful
The S&P filter chip is easy to miss among about 18 chips
